title: The King of Old School provokes Dusty Rhodes
summary: Steve Corino’s claims to represent old-school wrestling collide with an actual legend. Dusty Rhodes answers his insults with the bullrope match associated with his own career.

chapters.title: Dusty wins the bullrope fight
chapters.result: Rhodes defeats Corino in a Texas Bullrope match.
chapters.context: The veteran gives the self-appointed spokesman for tradition a direct lesson.

chapters.title: Corino wins the rematch
chapters.result: Corino defeats Rhodes in another bullrope match.
chapters.context: Jack Victory’s involvement helps Corino reverse the result against the legend.
